description: Everything ETFIQ publishes about one fund: issuer, category, and each figure with its source and as-of date, plus a one sentence verdict on how it did against what its own label promises. benchmark is the fund's own benchmark as its page names it: its name, how it was set, and the fund's return, the benchmark's and the gap for each window (periods is the page's whole window table). A closed fund answers with closed (the day and the page's words); a former ticker answers as the fund it trades as now, and says so. The ETFIQ benchmarks for model portfolios (list_benchmarks) are a different thing.
name: etf_profile
